BibVik is a project concerned with identifying trends in the published archaeological literature corresponding with shifting attitudes concerning the origins of the Viking Age.

[More on the project's priorities, values, context, inspiration, reason for being...]

This website hosts our preliminary research protocol, manuscript preprints, and other relevant materials.
All content is hosted and tracked at [github.com/zackbatist/BibVik](https://github.com/zackbatist/BibVik).
